samples.src: A simple mathematical modelling study
samples.ref: Nazarin ilimin lissafi mai sauƙi
samples.hyp: was conducted to assess the impact of different interventions on the spread of COVID-19 in a rural community. The model used data on population density, age structure, and contact patterns to simulate the transmission of the virus. The results of the study showed that targeted interventions, such as vaccination campaigns and public health education, were effective in reducing the spread of COVID-19.

samples.src: The novel Coronavirus disease (COVID-19), caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (SARS-CoV-2), in Africa is characterised by a more substantial proportion of asymptomatic (or mildly symptomatic) individuals thought to be playing a role in the spread of the infection.
samples.ref: Sabuwar cutar Coronavirus (COVID-19), wacce ta haifar da mummunar cutar sankarar numfashi ta coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2), a cikin Afirka tana da mafi girman adadin marasa alamar cuta (ko kuma marasa alamar cutar a hankali) mutane da ake tunanin suna taimakawa wajen yaɗuwar cutar.

samples.src: The exact proportion and degree of infectiousness of asymptomatic individuals remains unclear.
samples.ref: Ba a fayyace ainihin adadi da kuma matakin yaɗuwar cutar ga marasa alamar cutar ba.
samples.hyp: However, preliminary data suggest that asymptomatic individuals may contribute to the spread of the virus, especially in settings where testing is limited.

samples.src: Studies however indicate that their management is crucial for control of SARS-CoV-2 transmission.
samples.ref: Nazarin ya nuna duk da haka ya nuna cewa sarrafa su yana da mahimmanci don sarrafa yaɗuwar SARS-CoV-2.
samples.hyp: Hausa: Duk da haka, bincike ya nuna cewa kula da su na da mahimmanci wajen kawar da yaduwar SARS-CoV-2.

samples.src: We developed a simplified deterministic susceptible-exposed-infectious-removed (SEIR) mathematical model to assess the effect of active isolation of SARS-CoV-2 infected but asymptomatic individuals through blanket testing for control of the outbreak in Lusaka Province of Zambia.
samples.ref: Mun ƙirƙira ƙaddarar lissafi masu rauni mai sauƙi mai saurin yaɗuwa da cutar-cire (SEIR) don tantance tasirin keɓewar SARS-CoV-2 mai kamuwa da cuta amma marasa alamar cuta ta hanyar gwajin bargo don shawo kan ɓarkewar cutar a lardin Lusaka na Zambiya.

samples.src: Here we modelled two scenarios; (1) assuming asymptomatic individuals comprised 70% of all COVID-19 cases and (2) asymptomatic individuals comprised only 50% of the cases.
samples.ref: A nan mun tsara yanayi guda biyu; (1) ɗaukar mutane marasa alamar cuta da suka ƙunshi kashi 70% na duk kamuwa da COVID-19 da (2) marasa alamar cutar da suka ƙunshi kashi 50% na mutanen.

samples.src: For contrast, the model was assessed first under the assumption that asymptomatic individuals are equally as infectious as symptomatic individuals and then secondly, and more likely, assuming asymptomatic individuals are only half as infectious as symptomatic individuals.
samples.ref: Saqanin haka, an fara tantance samfurin da farko a ƙarƙashin zaton cewa mutanen marasa alamar cutar suna da yaɗuwar cutar kamar mutane masu alama sannan na biyu, kuma mafi kusantar, ɗauka cewa marasa alamar cutar suna da rabin masu kamuwa da cuta kamar masrasa alamar cutar.

samples.src: For the model assuming 70% asymptomatic cases, a minimum sustained daily blanket testing rate of ≥ 7911 tests/100000 population was sufficient to control the outbreak if asymptomatic individuals are only half as infectious while if equal infectiousness was assumed then a testing rate of ≥ 10028 tests/ 100000 population would be required.

samples.src: For 50% asymptomatic, minimum blanket testing rates of ≥ 4540 tests/ 100000 population was sufficient to control the outbreak at both assumed levels of infectiousness for asymptomatic individuals relative to symptomatic individuals.
samples.ref: Don kashi 50% na marasa alamar cutar, ƙarancin yawan gwajin bargo na ≥ 4540 gwaje-gwaje/yawan jama'a 100000 sun isa don sarrafa ɓarkewar cutar a duka matakan yaɗuwar cuta ga mutane marasa alamar cutar dangane da ɗaiɗaikun mutane masu alamar cutar.

samples.src: Discussion and conclusion
samples.ref: Tattaunawa da kammalawa
samples.hyp: : The results of this study show that the prevalence of hypertension in the study population was 25.7%. This is higher than the prevalence reported in previous studies in the same region. The high prevalence of hypertension may be due to a number of factors, including lifestyle, diet, and genetics. Further research is needed to determine the exact causes of hypertension in this population.

samples.src: Our model predicts that active isolation of COVID-19 cases, including asymptomatic individuals, through blanket testing can be used as a possible measure for the control of the SARS-Cov-2 transmission in Lusaka, Zambia, but it would come at a high cost.
samples.ref: Samfurinmu yana hasashen cewa keɓance aiki na kamuwar COVID-19, gami da marasa alamar cutar, ta hanyar gwajin bargo za a iya amfani da shi a zaman yiwuwar ma'auni don sarrafa yaɗuwar SARS-Cov-2 a Lusaka, Zambiya, amma zai zo da tsada.

samples.src: Because systematic evaluations of genetic prediction had not yet been conducted in ancestries that span African diversity, we calculated polygenic risk scores (PRS) in simulations across Africa and in empirical data from South Africa, Uganda, and the UK to better understand the generalizability of genetic studies.
samples.ref: Saboda har yanzu ba a gudanar da ƙididdigar hasashen ƙwayoyin gado ba a cikin kakannin da suka shafi bambance-bambancen Afirka, mun ƙididdige ma'aunin haɗarin ƙwayar gado da yawa (PRS) a cikin kwaikwaiyo a duk faɗin Afirka da kuma bayanan ƙwararru daga Afirka ta Kudu da Yuganda, da UK domin ƙarin fahimtar nazarin haɓakar ƙwayoyin gado.

samples.src: PRS accuracy improves with ancestry-matched discovery cohorts more than from ancestry-mismatched studies.
samples.ref: Daidaiton PRS yana haɓaka tare da rukunonin binciken da suka dace da kakanni fiye da binciken da bai dace da kakanni ba.
samples.hyp: The use of discovery cohorts matched to the ancestry of the individuals being studied can improve the accuracy of PRS, while studies that do not match the ancestry of the individuals being studied may not be as accurate.

samples.src: Within ancestrally and ethnically diverse South Africans, we find that PRS accuracy is low for all traits but varies across groups.
samples.ref: A tsakanin kakanni da ƙabilanci na ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu, mun gano cewa daidaiton PRS ba shi da ƙarfi ga kowace ɗabi'a amma ya bambanta a tsakanin rukunoni.

samples.src: Differences in African ancestries contribute more to variability in PRS accuracy than other large cohort differences considered between individuals in the UK versus Uganda.
samples.ref: Bambance-bambance a cikin ‘yan asalin Afirka suna bayar da gudummawa ga sauye-sauye a daidaiton PRS fiye da sauran manyan bambance-bambancen rukunoni da aka yi la'akari da su a tsakanin mutane a UK da kuma Yuganda.

samples.src: We computed PRS in African ancestry populations using existing European-only versus ancestrally diverse genetic studies; the increased diversity produced the largest accuracy gains for hemoglobin concentration and white blood cell count, reflecting large-effect ancestry-enriched variants in genes known to influence sickle cell anemia and the allergic response, respectively.
samples.ref: Mun ƙididdige PRS a cikin al’ummomin ‘yan asalin Afirka ta yin amfani da ɗimbin nazarin halittu na Turai-kawai tare da nazarin ƙwayoyin gado iri-iri na kakanni; bambance-bambancen da aka haɓaka ya haifar da mafi girman daidaiton daidaito don tattara haemoglobin da adadin fararen jini, yana nuna babban tasiri mai wadatar zuriyar jini a cikin ƙwayoyin gadon da aka sani don rinjayar cutar sikila da amsawar borin jini, bi-da-bi.

samples.src: Researchers say that current methods used to predict whether or not a person will develop a genetic disease doesn’t work well for people of African origin.
samples.ref: Masu bincike sun ce hanyoyin da ake amfani da su a halin yanzu don yin hasashen ko mutum zai kamu da cutar ko a'a ba ya aiki sosai ga mutane ‘yan asalin Afirka.

samples.src: This is because the database behind such predictions mostly describes genes of people of European origin.
samples.ref: Wannan shi ne saboda rumbun bayanan da ya yi irin wannan hasashe galibi yana bayyana ƙwayoyin gado ne na mutane ‘yan asalin Turai.

samples.src: The GWAS database stands for “Genome-Wide Association Studies”, and scientists use it to look for traits and diseases based on genes.
samples.ref: Taswirar rumbun bayanan GWAS tana nufin "Geneme-Wide Association Studies", kuma masana kimiyya suna amfani da shi don neman halaye da cututtuka dangane da ƙwayoyin gado.
samples.hyp: The database contains a lot of data about the relationship between genes and diseases.

samples.src: In fact, they can use the GWAS to calculate a person’s genetic risk for a disease or trait.
samples.ref: A gaskiya ma, za su iya amfani da GWAS domin ƙididdige haɗarin ƙwayar gadon mutum domin cuta ko hali.

samples.src: Most of the gene data in GWAS, however, comes from people of European ancestry.
samples.ref: Duk da haka, yawancin bayanan ƙwayoyin halitta a cikin GWAS, sun fito ne daga mutane ‘yan asalin Turai.
samples.hyp: This means that the results of these studies may not be applicable to people of other ancestries.

samples.src: In this study, researchers wanted to see how well the calculation they use to determine genetic disease risk using GWAS works for people of African ancestry.
samples.ref: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su ga yadda lissafin da suke amfani da shi don ƙayyade haɗarin cututtukan ƙwayoyin gado ta amfani da GWAS yana aiki ga mutane ‘yan asalin Afirka.

samples.src: They also wanted to see if a more diverse GWAS, in other words a database that includes more African genetic information, would improve the predictions.
samples.ref: Har wa yau, sun so su ga ko GWAS mai bambance-bambancen, ma'ana rumbun bayanai wanda ya ƙunshi ƙarin bayanan ƙwayoyin gadon Afirka, zai inganta hasashen.

samples.src: The calculation is known in more scientific terms as the “polygenic risk score”, or PRS.

samples.hyp: (RCT) was conducted to evaluate the efficacy and safety of a new drug for the treatment of hypertension. The study involved 500 participants, with 250 receiving the new drug and 250 receiving a placebo. The primary outcome measure was the change in systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 12. Secondary outcome measures included changes in diastolic blood pressure, heart rate, and the incidence of adverse events. The results showed that the new drug was more effective than the placebo in reducing systolic blood pressure, but there was no significant difference in diastolic blood pressure or heart rate. The incidence of adverse events was similar in both groups.

samples.src: In this study, a 30-day laboratory incubation experiment was done using 120 g samples each of a Haplic acrisol amended with corn cob biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut husk biochar (coco300 and coco700) or poultry manure compost (compost); and co- composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) or co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) at rates of 1 % w/w amendment: soil, respectively.
samples.ref: A wannan binciken, an yi gwajin xakin gwaji na kwanaki 30 ta hanyar amfani da samfuran 120 g na ko wanne na Haplic acrisol wanda aka gyara da gawayin ciyawar masara (cbio), gawayin vawon shinkafa (rbio), gawayin vawon kwakwa (coco300 da coco700) ko takin kaji (taki); da gawayin ruvavven vawon shinkafa (rcocomp) ko gawayin ciyawar masara (cococomp) a matakin gyara na 1% w/w: ƙasa, bi da bi.

samples.src: Other treatments in the study were combined poultry manure compost and corn cob biochar or rice husk biochar (1 % compost + 1% biochar: 1% soil w/w), respectively, to examine their effects on basal soil respiration, soil pH; soil microbial carbon; cation exchange capacity; total organic carbon, total nitrogen and available nitrogen concentration.

samples.src: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a painful and debilitating autoimmune condition, associated with inflammation in the joints and throughout the body.
samples.ref: Ciwon gaba (RA) ciwo ne mai zafi da tsanani sosai wanda ke faruwa indan garkuwan jiki ya sava tsari, kuma yana da alaqa da kumburi a duk gavvan jiki.
samples.hyp: It is characterized by chronic inflammation of the synovium, the lining of the joints.

samples.src: For some time now, scientists have known that sufferers of the disease also have a 50% higher risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes – like strokes or heart attacks.
samples.ref: Da daxewa masana kimiyya sun san cewa 50% na masu wannan cutar na iya kamuwa da cutar zuciya (CVD) mai haddasa garsa da bugun zuciya.

samples.src: A key factor in that risk is the effect inflammation has on the blood clotting process.
samples.ref: Hatsarin da ya fi girma shi ne alaqar kumburi da hanyar dunqulewar jini.

samples.src: In this study, researchers investigated this relationship, to find out exactly why RA heightens CVD risk.
samples.ref: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun zaqulo wannan alaqar, don gano takamammen abin da ya sa RA ke qara haxarin CVD.
samples.hyp: The study included 1,248 participants, of whom 62% were women. The average age of the participants was 58 years. The researchers analyzed data on the participants' medical history, lifestyle, and genetic information. The results showed that there was a significant association between RA and CVD, even after adjusting for other risk factors. This suggests that RA may have a direct impact on the development of CVD.

samples.src: More specifically, the researchers examined the effects of inflammation and structural changes on specific proteins associated with blood-clotting, called fibrins.
samples.ref: A taqaice dai, masu binciken sun gwada illar kumburi da canjin tsarin protin da ke da alaqa da dunqulewar jini wanda ake kira fibrins.

samples.src: These proteins occur as long chains that form the basic “mesh-work” for blood clots, so any changes to the fibrins themselves could have knock-on effects for the clotting process overall.
samples.ref: Waxannan sinadaran protin na faruwa ne kamar dogon layi mai sarqe da juma, saboda haka canjawar fabirins xin na iya shafar hanyoyin dunqulewar jini kai tsaye.

samples.src: In each case, the researchers were looking for “markers” in the blood that indicate inflammation, as well as for any unusual differences in the normal clotting process that could heighten CVD risk.

samples.src: The clots themselves were also analysed microscopically, to identify any changes to the structure of their fibrin proteins.

samples.src: There were also changes to the amino acids that make up the fibrin proteins, which caused them to trigger the body’s immune response, leading to further inflammation.

samples.src: Viewpoints of Other Scientists on Migration, Mental Health and PTSD:
samples.ref: Ra’ayoyin Sauran Masanan Kimiyya a kan Ƙaura da Lafiyar Ƙwaƙwalwa da kuma PTSD:
samples.hyp:
The relationship between migration and mental health is complex and multifaceted. Some studies suggest that migrants are at higher risk of experiencing mental health problems, such as depression and anxiety, while others indicate that migration can be a protective factor for mental health, especially for individuals who are fleeing conflict or persecution.
Furthermore, research has shown that individuals with PTSD are more likely to migrate, and that migration can exacerbate symptoms of PTSD.
The impact of migration on mental health and PTSD is influenced by a variety of factors, including the reasons for migration, the social and economic conditions in the host country, and the individual's resilience.

Glossary:
PTSD: Post-traumatic stress disorder (cutar wani mummunan lamari da ta haifar da tashin hankali)
Resilience: (Ƙarfi, damar shawo kan matsaloli)
Host country: (Ƙasar da aka tafi)

samples.hyp: The parasite multiplies in the liver and red blood cells, causing symptoms such as fever, chills, and anemia. In severe cases, malaria can lead to complications such as cerebral malaria and organ failure.

samples.src: Upon entry into the body, Plasmodium heads straight for the liver to reproduce - this early stage is ideal for antimalarial treatment because there are no disease symptoms yet and the disease can’t be transmitted.

They analyzed samples from patients with liver disease to identify these changes. The goal was to understand how these changes affect the body's response to the infection and to develop new ways to treat the disease.

samples.src: One of the key findings is that Plasmodium hijacks the microtubules in liver cells - instead of the microtubules clustering around the nucleus delivering nutrients and materials to where the cell needs it, the microtubules cluster around the parasite delivering nutrients and materials to help the parasite reproduce.

samples.src: Edaphic factors controlling soil organic matter and C storage in miombo woodlands, Zambia
samples.ref: Abubuwan da suke sarrafa ƙwayoyin halitta na ƙasa da kuma ajiyar C a cikin gandun daji na miombo, ƙasar Zambiyaa

samples.src: Soil organic matter (SOM) is a key component of forest productivity and soil organic carbon stock.
samples.ref: Ƙwayoyin halitta na ƙasa (SOM) mahimmin sashi ne na yawan amfanin gandun daji da kuma ƙwayar kabon ta ƙasa.
samples.hyp: It plays a vital role in maintaining soil health and fertility. SOM is influenced by various factors, including climate, vegetation, and land management practices. The study aimed to assess the impact of different land management practices on SOM in a tropical forest ecosystem.

samples.src: However, little is known about SOM and C variability in miombo woodlands which is a significant ecosystem in sub-Sahara African forests and vital for REDD+ strategies.
samples.ref: Duk da haka, kaɗan aka sani game da bambancin SOM da C a cikin gandun daji na miombo wanda shi ne muhimmin yanayin halitta a cikin dazuzzukan Afirka kudu da saharar kuma yana da mahimmanci ga dabarun REDD+.

samples.src: In this study, nine edaphic factors were measured and used to analyse the variability of SOM in miombo woodland sites with different tree structures in Luanshya, Zambia.
samples.ref: A cikin binciken, an auna abubuwan yanayi na ƙasa yake haifarwa guda tara kuma an yi amfani da su don nazarin bambancin SOM a cikin gandun daji na miombo tare da tsarin bishiyoyi daban-daban a Luanshya, ta ƙasa Zambiya.

samples.src: The findings showed a large variability of SOM stocks at different soil depths:
samples.ref: Sakamakon binciken ya nuna babban bambancin tarin SOM a zurfin ƙasa daban-daban:
samples.hyp:
the highest values were observed at 20-40 cm depth, while the lowest values were recorded at 0-10 cm depth. This suggests that SOM is stored in deeper soil layers.

Hausa:
Binciken ya nuna bambance-bambancen da ke nan a adadin SOM a zuruffuffan ƙasa daban-daban: mafi yawan adadi sun faru a zuruffan 20-40 cm, yayin da mafi ƙarancin adadi sun kasance a zuruffan 0-10 cm. Wannan ya nuna cewa adadin SOM yana adanawa a zuruffuffan ƙasan ƙasa.

samples.src: 36.67 to 113.89 Mg ha-1 at 0–10 cm depth, 28.67 to 79.56 Mg ha-1 at 10–20 cm depth, and 31.89 to 98.56 Mg ha-1 at 20–30 cm depth.
samples.ref: 36.67 zuwa 113.89 Mg ha-1 a zurfin 0-10 cm, 28.67 zuwa 79.56 Mg ha-1 a zurfin 10-20 cm, da kuma 31.89 zuwa 98.56 Mg ha-1 a zurfin 20-30 cm.
samples.hyp: The highest concentration was observed in the 20–30 cm depth.

samples.src: These SOM values at different depths also varied between miombo woodland sites of different successional stages, notably that areas affected by recent tree clearance had higher than average SOM content per layer (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).
samples.ref: Hakan nan waɗannan darajojin SOM a zurfi daban-daban kuma sun bambanta a tsakanin ɓangarorin gandun daji na miombo na matakai daban-daban, musamman cewa yankunan da yanke bishiyoyi ya shafa kwanan nan sun sami mafi girma fiye da matsakaicin abun ciki na SOM a kowane shimfiɗa (0-10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).

samples.src: Canonical correspondence analysis (CCA) revealed that the most significant environmental factors influencing SOM were woodland thinning by clearance, and silt content within soils.
samples.ref: Binciken halittu da muhallinsu (CCA) ya bayyana cewa mafi mahimmancin abubuwan muhalli da suke tasiri a kan SOM su ne rage yawan gandun daji ta hanyar sharewa, da kuma abubuwan cikin ƙasa.

samples.src: This study highlights that CCA can be used to show the relative importance of different forest successional stages as a function of management practices, as well as edaphic factors, in determining miombo soil SOM content.
samples.ref: Wannan binciken ya nuna cewa za a iya amfani da CCA don nuna mahimmancin matakan dazuzzuka daban-daban a matsayin aikin gudanar da ayyukan gudanarwa, da kuma abubuwan da yanayi na ƙasa yake haifarwa, wajen ƙayyade abun SOM na ƙasar miombo.

samples.src: The results of this study are particularly relevant for addressing current REDD+ reforestation and management strategies that are aimed at increasing carbon stocks in the tropical forests of sub-Saharan Africa.
samples.ref: Sakamakon wannan binciken yana da mahimmanci musamman don magance yanayin sake shuka bishiyoyi na REDD+ na yanzu da kuma dabarun gudanarwa waɗanda suke da nufin haɓaka kayan kabon a cikin dazuzzuka na wurare masu zafi na yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara.

samples.src: What Makes a Woman?
samples.ref: Me Ke Yi Mace?
samples.hyp:
The question of what makes a woman has been debated for centuries, and there is no single answer. However, there are several factors that contribute to a woman's identity, including biological factors, social roles, and personal experiences.

Biological factors include a woman's reproductive system, hormones, and genetic makeup. Social roles include the expectations and norms that society places on women, such as being caregivers, mothers, and wives. Personal experiences include a woman's individual life events, relationships, and achievements.

samples.src: Case Studies Documenting The Reasons for and Circumstances of Female Genital Mutilation/Cutting in Indonesia, Ethiopia and Kenya
samples.ref: Keɓaɓɓen Nazari Domin Adana Dalilai da Halin Kaciyar Mata a ƙasashen Indonesia da Habasha da kuma Kenya

.
English: This report summarizes the findings of case studies conducted in Indonesia, Ethiopia, and Kenya to understand the reasons for and circumstances of female genital mutilation/cutting.

Hausa:
Wannan rahoton ya rufe sakamakon binciken da aka gudanar a Indunesia, Habasha, da Kenya, domin fahimtar dalilan da kuma yanayin da ake yin cutar da/ƙara wa yayan.

samples.src: Female genital cutting/mutilation is a harmful traditional practice that violates women’s rights and has adverse health consequences.
samples.ref: Yanke al’aurar mata al’ada ce mai cutarwa da take take haƙƙin mata kuma tana da illa ga lafiya.

samples.src: This paper presents the reasons for and circumstances of female genital mutilation/ cutting (FGM/C) in specific settings of three countries – Indonesia, Ethiopia and Kenya.
samples.ref: Wannan takarda ta gabatar da dalilai da kuma yanayin kaciyar mata (FGM/C) a takamaiman wurare na ƙasashe uku – Indonesiya da Habasha da kuma Kenya.
samples.hyp: The study also examines the impact of FGM/C on the health and well-being of women.

samples.src: Data were collected through a household survey with young people (15-24 years) and through focus group discussions, in-depth interviews and key informant interviews with youth and community stakeholders in 2016 and 2017.
samples.ref: An tattara bayanai ta hanyar binciken gida tare da matasa (shekaru 15-24) da kuma ta hanyar tattaunawa ta rukuni, tattaunawa mai zurfi da kuma mahimman tambayoyin masu bayars da labari tare da matasa da masu ruwa da tsaki a cikin shekarar 2016 da kuma shekarar 2017.

samples.src: Descriptive statistics and thematic content analysis were conducted.
samples.ref: An gudanar da ƙididdiga masu bayyanawa da kuma nazarin abubuwan da ke cikin jigo.
samples.hyp: The study population consisted of 1,250 participants, of whom 62.5% were women and 37.5% were men. The mean age of the participants was 35.2 years, with a standard deviation of 8.5 years. The majority of participants (78%) were between the ages of 25 and 19 years.

samples.src: The study findings confirm some of the reasons for FGM/C documented by previous studies, noting that these reasons are strongly interconnected, and gender norms are the underlying driver.
samples.ref: Sakamakon binciken ya tabbatar da wasu dalilai na FGM/C da aka rubuta ta binciken da aka yi a baya, lura da cewa waɗannan dalilai suna da alaƙa da juna sosai, kuma ƙajidodin jinsi su ne musabbabin tushen.

samples.src: In all three settings, these reasons drive the alterations of female bodies to result in a ‘cultured’ body that is acceptable to the patriarchal status quo.
samples.ref: A cikin dukkan wuraren guda uku, waɗannan dalilai suna haifar da sauye-sauye na jikin mata don haifar da jiki mai 'al’ada' wanda ya dace da matsayin sarki.
samples.hyp: A cikin dukkanin wurare uku, dalilan waɗannan sun haifar da canje-canje a jikin mata domin samar da jikin 'mai tarbiyya' wanda ya dace da tsarin mulkin patriyarka.

samples.src: This results in the ‘pure body’ in Indonesia, the ‘tame’ body in Ethiopia and the ‘adult body’ in Kenya.

samples.hyp: These are all part of a larger cultural context that influences the way people perceive and interact with their bodies.

samples.src: Health workers and parents play an important role in decision-making around FGM/C in all settings.
samples.ref: Ma'aikatan lafiya da iyaye suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen yanke shawara game da FGM/C a duk wurare.

samples.src: In Kenya, in particular, young women negotiate their role in decision-making around FGM/C as they are older at the time of circumcision.
samples.ref: A ƙasar Kenya, musamman, mata matasa suna tattaunawa game da rawar da suke takawa wajen yanke shawara game da FGM/C yayin da suka girma a lokacin kaciyar.

samples.src: The study reveals how the changing legal and social contexts in each setting bring about changes in the tradition of FGM/C resulting in medicalization of FGM/C in Indonesia, a lowered age of cutting for girls in Kenya and the increasingly underground practice of FGM/C in Ethiopia.
samples.ref: Binciken ya bayyana yadda sauye-sauyen yanayi na shari'a da zamantakewa a kowane wuri ya haifar da sauye-sauyen a al'adar FGM/C wanda ke haifar da likitanci na FGM/C a ƙasar Indonesiya, rage shekarun yanke wa 'yan mata a ƙasar Kenya da kuma ƙara yawan aikin FGM/ C a ƙasar habasha.

samples.src: The three cases demonstrate the huge variation in the practice of FGM/C and the social meaning attributed to it by young women and their communities.
samples.ref: Faruwar guda uku sun nuna babban bambanci a cikin aikin FGM/C da ma'anar zamantakewar mata matasa da al’ummominsu.

samples.src: There is a need to further explore the role of parents in decision-making.
samples.ref: Akwai buƙatar a ƙara binciko rawar da iyaye suke taka wa wajen yanke shawara.

samples.src: Due to the links between the different drivers of FGM/C within each context, the study concludes that context-specific strategies need to be adopted by interventions to create long-lasting change.
samples.ref: Saboda alaƙar da take tsakanin musabbabai daban-daban na FGM/C a cikin kowane mahallin, binciken ya ƙaddamar da cewa takamaiman dabarun mahallin yana buƙatar ɗaukar matakai ta hanyar shiga tsakani domin samar da sauyi mai ɗorewa.

samples.src: To stop female genital mutilation, we first need to understand why it’s happening

samples.src: Female genital mutilation, a practice where parts of the female sex organs are cut or removed, still happens illegally or in secret in countries like Kenya, Ethiopia and Indonesia.
samples.ref: Kaciyar mata, al’adar da ake yanke ko cire sassan sassan jikin mace, har yanzu tana faruwa ba bisa ƙa'ida ba ko kuma a asirce a ƙasashe irin su Kenya da Habasha da kuma Indonesiya.

samples.src: We analyzed serum reproductive hormones, sperm reserve and quality as well as testicular ultrastructural changes following SMV treatment.

samples.ref: Amfanin Al'adu na Tsirrai na Gida a cikin Al'ummar ’Yan Asalin Arewa-Maso-Yammacin Habasha

English:
The study assessed the cultural use of homegarden plants by members of an indigenous community in North West Ethiopia. Data were collected through focus group discussions and key informant interviews. The results showed that a wide range of plants are used for various purposes, including medicinal, nutritional, and domestic uses. The study also revealed that the community has a deep understanding of the properties and uses of these plants, and that this knowledge is passed down from generation to generation.

Glossary:
* Homegarden:  Gidan noma
* Indigenous community: Al'ummar asali
* Focus group discussions: Taron magana
* Key informant interviews: Tattaunawa da masana
* Medicinal:  Layin magani
* Nutritional:  Abinci
* Domestic uses: Amfani a gida

Hausa:
Binciken ya duba yadda al'ummar asali a arewa maso yammacin Ethiopia ke amfani da kayan gidan noma. An tattara bayanai ta taron magana da tattaunawa da masana. Sakamakon binciken ya nuna cewa kayan gidan noma da dama ana amfani da su don dalilai daban-daban, kamar magani, abinci, da amfani a gida. Haka kuma, binciken ya bayyana cewa al'umma ta da fahimta game da halayen da amfanin wannan kayan, kuma wannan ilimin yana wucewa daga wuri zuwa wuri.
